svg.aria-label: How Movie Script Scraper gets scripts. You run it from the command line or as an npm package with a genre, like Action, and a total, 10 by default. It loads that genre's page on IMSDB, the Internet Movie Script Database, and finds every link to a script. It fetches five scripts at a time, retrying a failed request up to three times and waiting 1, 2 and then 4 seconds. From each page it keeps the script text and skips anything under 500 characters. Each script is saved as a text file in a folder named for the genre. Bechdel.io's scripts came from it.
